Question:
A prospect thinks Northstar will replace both their BI dashboards and their system of record. How should I explain the approved relationship with BI and the system-of-record limitation?

Retrieved context (grouped by document):
=== Document: SALES-003 — Competitive Battlecard ===

[Section: Positioning Against Generic BI Tools]
Chunk ID: 802e3b03-c3a7-49cb-a1d4-bfc3cd9bd8ed
Score: 0.8046
Content:
Positioning Against Generic BI Tools

When compared with generic BI tools, position Northstar as workflow-aware analytics. Generic BI tools can report metrics, but Northstar connects metrics to approvals, queues, owners, and operational follow-up.

Approved response: "Northstar complements BI by helping operations teams act on workflow issues, not just view dashboards."

[Section: Positioning Against Workflow Tools]
Chunk ID: e4ccd836-49df-48c8-b260-8e8a706a4228
Score: 0.6877
Content:
Positioning Against Workflow Tools

When compared with workflow-only tools, position Northstar as analytics plus process visibility. Workflow tools coordinate tasks, while Northstar tracks patterns, bottlenecks, and KPI impact across workflows.

=== Document: SALES-002 — Product Positioning and FAQ ===

[Section: Product Limitations]
Chunk ID: 19356584-26af-4941-b6fe-9e95dea899e0
Score: 0.8160
Content:
Product Limitations

Northstar is not a replacement for a system of record, identity provider, ERP, or clinical decision system. Sales Representatives should not promise unsupported integrations, exact roadmap delivery dates, or customer-specific contract commitments.

[Section: Integrations]
Chunk ID: 8d4e31c2-d911-433c-892c-fb68cb73f2db
Score: 0.6442
Content:
Integrations

Northstar supports common data warehouse, ticketing, and workflow integrations through approved connectors and APIs. Sales Representatives should confirm exact integration support with Solutions Engineering.

[Section: Core Value Proposition]
Chunk ID: e638403c-0301-4b94-b636-04e2fdd6c813
Score: 0.6029
Content:
Core Value Proposition

Northstar Analytics gives operations teams one place to monitor workflows, approvals, data quality issues, and executive KPIs. The strongest message is operational visibility with measurable process improvement.

[Section: Industry Use Cases]
Chunk ID: 071114dc-f57a-4db5-b12a-f22114a65a0c
Score: 0.5594
Content:
Industry Use Cases

Finance operations teams use Northstar to track approval delays and reconciliation exceptions. Healthcare operations teams use it to monitor non-clinical workflow bottlenecks. Logistics teams use it to track exception queues and service-level risks. Professional services teams use it to monitor delivery workflows and client reporting readiness.

=== Document: IT-001 — Acceptable Use Policy ===

[Section: Approved Use]
Chunk ID: 27583c5a-ba2e-4d83-b7b6-a933c0360595
Score: 0.6962
Content:
Approved Use

Northstar systems must be used for company business, approved learning, customer support, and authorized operational work. Employees may use company devices for limited personal use if it does not interfere with work, create security risk, or violate policy.

=== Document: SALES-001 — Sales Playbook ===

[Section: Approved Talk Track]
Chunk ID: 4f057818-24db-49a8-be3b-73811b3d858c
Score: 0.5902
Content:
Approved Talk Track

Northstar helps operations leaders see where work slows down, which approvals are delayed, and which data quality issues affect business reporting. Sales Representatives should avoid promising product roadmap commitments.

=== Document: HR-001 — Employee Handbook ===

[Section: Company Overview]
Chunk ID: 9cc339b6-8f98-422e-b2bf-e01f705ea379
Score: 0.5828
Content:
Company Overview

Northstar Analytics builds analytics and workflow automation software for operations teams in finance, healthcare operations, logistics, and professional services. Employees are expected to protect customer trust, communicate clearly, and make decisions that improve operational reliability.

Northstar has offices in Toronto, Montreal, and New York. The company supports hybrid work and approved remote work across Canada and the United States.

=== Document: IT-003 — Data Classification and Handling Policy ===

[Section: Classification Levels]
Chunk ID: 71a7e7e6-af8a-4b5d-b77b-852b30df7f5a
Score: 0.5797
Content:
Classification Levels

Northstar uses four data classification levels: Public, Internal, Confidential, and Restricted.

Public data is approved for external sharing. Internal data is intended for Northstar employees. Confidential data includes customer business information, financial forecasts, non-public sales materials, and employee operational data. Restricted data includes secrets, credentials, regulated customer data, privileged security records, and sensitive HR case material.
